item.title: Agent Skills by Addy Osmani — Enforcing Senior Engineering Discipline on Agents
item.description: In the previous two parts of this series we have seen an overview of agent-driven engineering and then Every's compound engineering methodology. Now for another similar approach: Agent Skills, Addy Osmani's project at Google that has nearly 30,000 stars on GitHub and tackles the problem from a completely different …
